subject: Geospatial Technology
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Self-Management Skills - III in CBSE Class 11 Geospatial Technology.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 Geospatial Technology (818), Unit-2: Self-Management Skills - III covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
